In the performance of its furctions, the Council is hereby
authorized to call upon any department, bureau, office, agency or
instrumentality of the Government for such information, professional
consultation and assistance as it may need.
The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Rescurces is authorized
to organize a Provincial Forestry Courcil in each province where it
is needed, the members of which shall be the following:
The District Forester
The Provincial Commander, Provincial Constabulary
The Provincial Fiscal
The Division Superintendent of Schools
A representative of a civic organization to be
appointed hy the Secretary of Arriculture and
Natural Resources
A representative of the Provincial Governor
A forestry licensee to he appointed hy the Secretary
of Agriculture and Natural Resources
The Chairman shall he chosen by the Secretary of Agriculture
and Natural Resources from among the members of the Council.
The Provincial Forestry Council shall have the following functions:
(1) To implement and coordinate the action program of forest con-
servation and reforestation in the province; and
(2) To advise the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Rescurces
on the problems affecting forest conservation and reforestation and
to make surgestions for their solution.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of November, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-four, and of the
Independence of the Philippines, the ninth.
(SGD. ) RAMON MAGSAYSAY
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) FRED RUIZ CASTRO
Executive Secretary
